resources.string: First steps
Let\'s start with an account
Done: %1$d of %2$d · Next: %3$s
Done: %1$d of %2$d. You can skip any step.
Hide steps
Add an account
Where your money is: a card, cash or savings. Start with one.
Record your first expense
Any one, even a coffee. Tap “+”.
Set your first limit
How much you are happy to spend on groceries a month. You can change it.
Invite someone close
It is easier together. Or later.
Hints
Shown
Off
Show hints again
Brings back “First steps” and tips
Tap the card to flip it: the back has the most useful things of the month.
Swipe sideways to switch tabs.
Dismiss tip
No transactions yet. Tap “+” to add the first one.
An account is where your money sits. The balance adds up by itself.
Got a QR on the receipt? Tap the camera icon: the amount and date fill in by themselves.
A category is what the money went on. The ready-made ones will do; add your own later.
A limit is how much you can spend on a category in a month. A guide, not a ban.
Here you see where the money goes. The more entries, the clearer the picture.
A tag is a coloured label on a transaction, like “holiday” or “gifts”.
Easier together: entries from both phones come together in one place.
Got it
Press and hold a transaction to select several.
Made a mistake? Tap the transaction to fix it.
The first entry is in. This is how a budget begins.
Limit set. Now you can see how much is left.
Tips are on
All set
You are already keeping a budget — and that is the hardest part.
A week of entries. Order in your money starts with this.
Welcome back. You can add what you spent in these days: pick the date in the transaction.
You have plenty of entries now. Save a backup so nothing is lost: More → Backup.
You can make the app your own: More → Appearance.
Spending repeats? Save a template and it goes in with one tap.
Open
%1$s: you can still spend %2$s. Look into “Budgets” whenever you like.
The month is over. See the totals: Reports.
Only the amount and the account are needed. You can skip the rest.
You can add and subtract: 300 + 150.
Got money back? Tick “This is a refund”.
Money in another currency? Totals are counted in your totals currencies, the rate is filled in for you.
Enter the purchase amount and the rate is worked out for you.
